caption: The drawing depicts a brown bottle, shown at actual size, with an oval body and a short cylindrical neck. On the main face of the bottle, there is a detailed embossed image of an eagle with outstretched wings. The eagle has a shield with vertical and horizontal stripes on its chest, holds arrows in its left talon, and an olive branch in its right talon. Below the eagle is a recessed rectangular area. To the left of the main image, there is a line drawing labeled "REVERSE SIDE OF BOTTLE," which shows a cornucopia overflowing with various fruits and vegetables, including grapes, a pineapple, and several round fruits. Beneath the bottle, there is a simple cross-sectional drawing labeled "ACTUAL PLAN OF 1/2 OF BASE," showing the curved profile of the base. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color, and there is no shading or additional coloring except for the brown rendering of the bottle itself.
title: Flask
